content:
emma: ok - need to lock GPU commit window for UK/FR rollout. Customer SLAs pushing for dedicated capacity. Who can summarize lead times and minimal commit size? cc @ryan @priya
ryan: procurement lead time ~14-18 weeks for Ampere A800s from current vendors. if we want Q4 availability we need PO by end of month. also need rack space and power reservations.
priya: agree. from utilization side we should target fleet utilisation <=65% average to keep headroom for spikes. that means reserve ~30% headroom on commits.
marcus: budget check — what's ballpark capex? rough calc: 4 pods * 8 A800 = 32 GPUs/pod. unit cost + infra = ~$120k per pod upfront (estimate). need finance signoff.
liu: major customer (FinApps) requires 99.95% regional SLA and burstable capacity. They'll accept multi-region fallback but prefer UK local.
emma: launch criteria proposal: 1) reserved capacity in UK >= 48 GPUs, 2) P95 gen latency < 200ms on typical prompt, 3) on-call runbooks and rollback verified, 4) can auto-fallback to EU region within 30s.
ryan: operational notes: enable KV cache warmers, continuous batching tuned for seq=1024. also recommend model-variant fallback (quantized) to reduce tail pressure.
priya: suggested OKRs to attach: Infra Q4: 'Provide 99.95% UK coverage for enterprise customers' (KRs: hold P95 <200ms, maintain <=65% avg utilization, support 100rps sustained).
marcus: finance question: commit length options? 12mo vs 36mo reduces unit price by ~18%. need procurement to model both.
emma: prioritize — tradeoffs: if we shorten commit window we might need higher price and reduce headroom. prefer to align with sales commitments next week.
infra-bot: procurement sheet updated: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-1723 - UK-procurement-2026. Current ETA by vendor: 16 weeks. PO draft available.
liu: customer update — FinApps can flex on exact GPU count if we guarantee latency and burst SLA. They prefer soft commitment + penalty structure.
ryan: action items: 1) emma/priya: produce capacity plan w/ utilization sims by Tue. 2) marcus: proc pricing scenarios by Wed. 3) supply chain: confirm rack lead time. I'll validate fallback test run.
emma: thanks. will sync with sales leadership Thursday 10am. cc @liu please join. :thumbsup:
